subtitle: Lesson 29 · Capstone: Deploying and Administering an AWS Environment

code:
aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.50.0.0/16

aws ec2 create-subnet --cidr-block 10.50.1.0/24 \
  --tag ... Value=meridian-public-subnet

aws ec2 create-subnet --cidr-block 10.50.2.0/24 \
  --tag ... Value=meridian-private-subnet
caption: The public slice will hold the web tier; the private slice holds the app tier.

code:
aws ec2 create-internet-gateway
aws ec2 attach-internet-gateway --vpc-id vpc-0meridian01 ...

aws ec2 create-route --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 \
  --gateway-id igw-0meridian01

aws ec2 modify-subnet-attribute --subnet-id subnet-0meridianpub \
  --map-public-ip-on-launch
caption: A route to the gateway, plus auto-assigned public IPs — both, not either.

steps.label: S3 bucket
steps.sub: shared app data, not local disk

code:
aws ec2 run-instances --subnet-id subnet-0meridianpub \
  --associate-public-ip-address --tag ... Value=meridian-web1

aws ec2 run-instances --subnet-id subnet-0meridianpriv \
  --tag ... Value=meridian-app1

aws s3api create-bucket --bucket meridian-outfitters-app-data \
  --region us-east-1
caption: Same AMI, same instance type — the subnet and the flags decide reachability.
